I found two errors in `catalog-info.yaml`. Either one would stop Backstage from accepting the entity. I didn't change any files.

**How I checked:** I read the file and ran the skill's structure checker on it (`node .claude/skills/backstage-catalog-builder/scripts/check-descriptors.mjs catalog-info.yaml`). ## Errors

1. **`metadata.name` isn't a valid name** (`catalog-info.yaml:4`)
   `Ledger Sync!` has a space and a `!`. By default, Backstage only accepts letters and numbers, joined by single `-`, `_` or `.` characters.
   - **Suggested fix:** `name: ledger-sync`. That matches the repository's `README.md:1` heading (`# ledger-sync`).
   - To keep the readable name on screen, add `title: Ledger Sync` under `metadata`.

2. **`spec.owner` is missing** (`catalog-info.yaml:1`, the Component)
   Every Component needs an owner, such as `owner: group:default/<team>`.
   - The repository has no CODEOWNERS file, no other descriptors and no other mention of an owner, so I have no evidence for a value. You'll need to name the owning group or user. Don't use a made-up placeholder.

## Things to confirm (not errors)

- **`spec.lifecycle: production`** is a valid value. Nothing in the repository supports or contradicts it, so make sure it's correct.
- **No annotations.** Annotations such as `github.com/project-slug` aren't required, but integrations like source links and CI views need them. I couldn't find the repository's remote URL (the folder isn't a git checkout), so I didn't suggest a value.

## Not checked

- **API contracts and deployment files:** I found none in the repository.
- **The `description`** matches the README, so it's fine as is.

Once you've decided on the owner and the name, I can make these edits and re-run the checker.
